description: Source file for system configuration and clock management on a Synopsys ARC-based SoC, including PLL configuration, clock dividers, and peripheral clock control functions.

methods.name: arc_iot_pll_conf_reg
methods.description: Configures the PLL register with a given value, setting clock source and resetting PLL.

methods.name: arc_iot_pll_fout_config
methods.description: Configures the PLL output frequency based on a specified frequency value.

methods.name: arc_iot_ahb_clk_divisor
methods.description: Sets the AHB clock divisor.

methods.name: arc_iot_ahb_clk_enable
methods.description: Enables AHB clock for a specific device.

methods.name: arc_iot_ahb_clk_disable
methods.description: Disables AHB clock for a specific device.

methods.name: arc_iot_apb_clk_divisor
methods.description: Sets the APB clock divisor.

methods.name: arc_iot_apb_clk_enable
methods.description: Enables APB clock for a specific device.

methods.name: arc_iot_apb_clk_disable
methods.description: Disables APB clock for a specific device.

methods.name: arc_iot_dio_clk_divisor
methods.description: Sets the DIO clock divisor.

methods.name: arc_iot_spi_master_clk_divisor
methods.description: Sets the clock divisor for SPI master interfaces.

methods.name: arc_iot_gpio8b_dbclk_div
methods.description: Sets the debounce clock divisor for GPIO bank 8B.

methods.name: arc_iot_gpio4b_dbclk_div
methods.description: Sets the debounce clock divisor for GPIO bank 4B.

methods.name: arc_iot_i2s_tx_clk_div
methods.description: Sets the I2S transmit clock divisor.

methods.name: arc_iot_i2s_rx_clk_div
methods.description: Sets the I2S receive clock divisor.

methods.name: arc_iot_i2s_rx_clk_sel
methods.description: Selects the I2S receive clock source.

methods.name: arc_iot_syscon_reset
methods.description: Performs system reset via SYSCON.

methods.name: arc_iot_is_poweron_rst
methods.description: Checks if the reset was a power-on reset.

methods.name: arc_iot_dvfs_clk_divisor
methods.description: Sets the clock divisor for DVFS performance levels.

methods.name: arc_iot_dvfs_vdd_config
methods.description: Configures the voltage for different DVFS performance levels.

methods.name: arc_iot_dvfs_vwtime_config
methods.description: Sets the voltage switch time for DVFS.

methods.name: arc_iot_pmc_pwwtime_config
methods.description: Sets the power-down wait time.

methods.name: arc_iot_uart3_clk_divisor
methods.description: Sets UART3 clock divisor.

methods.name: arc_iot_reset_powerdown_vector
methods.description: Sets the reset power-down vector address.

methods.name: arc_iot_pwm_timer_pause
methods.description: Pauses or resumes PWM timers.

methods.name: arc_iot_eflash_clk_div
methods.description: Sets the eFlash clock divider.
